name: Loaning Money
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lend money without charging interest, especially to those in need, reflecting God's compassion and mercy (Exodus 22:25; Deuteronomy 23:19). Lending to others is seen as an act of kindness that honors the Lord, with a reminder that the borrower becomes a servant to the lender (Proverbs 19:17; Proverbs 22:7). Christ warns against lending solely for personal gain, encouraging generosity without expectation of repayment, even toward friends or those who may not repay (Psalms 37:21; Luke 6:34).
